text: Overdosage If you accidentaly swallow some ointment If you accidentally swallow the ointment, consult your doctor or pharmacist as soon as possible. Do not try to induce Vomiting. If you forget to use Tacrus ® If you forget to apply the ointment at the scheduled time, do it as soon as you remember and then continue as before. If you have any further questions on the use of this product, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
